newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco bourse closes a shade lower in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Morocco bourse closes a shade lower in thin trade.

text.p: Morocco's stock exchange closed on Monday 0.20 percent lower with low volumes in the few stocks traded on the official market, stockbrokers said.
The Casablanca bourse all-share index closed at 637.11 points from 638.40 points last Friday.

In the banking sector, Wafabank fell 10 dirhams to 780 dirhams with 918 shares traded. Banque Marocaine du Commerce et de l'Industrie and Banque Marocaine du Commerce Exterieur were down respectively five and four dirhams to 490 and 596 dirhams.
Societe Nationale d'Investissement, the second largest private group, gained seven dirhams to 720 dirhams.
First and second tranche of privatisation bonds, issued in January and May 1996, were up one and 16 dirhams to respectively 1,340 and 1,162 dirhams.
"People are positioning themeselves on bonds which they think are more reliable than shares which have been subject to sharp fluctuations since April," a broker at BMCI Securities said.
In the energy sector, oil refinery Samir, edged up two dirhams to 343 dirhams with 2,648 shares exchanged.
Steel mill Sonasid remained unchanged at 550 dirhams.
Maroc Leasing was up three dirhams to 419 dirhams and portfolio firm Financiere Diwan, one dirham to 331 dirhams.
Total traded volume on the official market was 14.7 million from 27 million dirhams.
On the over-the-counter market, the volume was 136 million dirhams from 26.1 million dirhams. accounted for main trade on this market with 128,570 shares changing hands.
